response.justification: Bogdan brings valuable geospatial domain expertise and a strong track record of learning complex systems across multiple technology stacks. However, his decade-long gap in C++ development is a significant concern for a role requiring 'modern C++' as the primary language, and the absence of Rust experience eliminates an acceptable alternative. While his proven ability to master distributed systems and infrastructure suggests he could potentially ramp up quickly, verifying current C++ or Rust capabilities would be essential before proceeding.
strengths: Deep geospatial domain expertise with multiple production systems, including the open-source GISCollective platform used by conservation organizations globally
Proven track record of mastering diverse technology stacks and systems-level programming, including distributed infrastructure handling millions of concurrent requests
Senior-level engineer with full-stack flexibility, focus on testable code and quality assurance, and demonstrated willingness to expand expertise into new domains
concerns: No modern C++ development in over 10 years (last professional C++ work 2014–2015); current focus for past 3+ years exclusively on JavaScript/TypeScript and web technologies
No Rust programming experience, which is explicitly listed as an acceptable alternative to C++ in job requirements
Geospatial background is in data collection and mapping platforms rather than production navigation/routing systems or tile-based optimization

key_factors.factor: C++ language skills gap (10+ years since last professional experience)
Geospatial domain expertise and open-source infrastructure contributions
Proven ability to master new technology stacks and complex systems
